facilities.description:
Open only from autumn to spring (according to the partner's website).

Spa at Náplavka on the steamer Avoid Gallery on the Rašín embankment. A classic Finnish sauna with a view of Hradčany, a relaxation area, a changing room, a shower, cooling showers and a jetty into the river.

Mon - Sun: 18 - 23

Before visiting the sauna, it is advisable to reserve a place for a specific time and number of people, the reservation is possible online in the reservation section, by phone or by email.

facilities.name: Max Fitness Bílá Labuť
facilities.description: The fitness center is located in the prestigious location of Bílá Labuta in the center of Prague. It offers modern equipment from the Life Fitness and Booty Builder brands, a spacious cardio zone and strength training machines for strength training, a Ladies zone with Matrix equipment, including a complete line of Booty Builder machines. There is also a Finnish sauna, which is free to enter as part of a fitness visit. You will also find body diagnostics measurements using the InBody device.

facilities.name: Max Fitness Flora
facilities.description: The top-equipped fitness center, covering an area of ​​2,500 m², is located in the Atrium Flora shopping center. It offers Matrix and Booty Builder machines, an extensive cardio zone, a free Finnish sauna and an Ergoline solarium. Parking + 3 hours free upon presentation of a parking ticket at the reception. Measurements on the InBody device will provide you with an accurate analysis of your results and help you set appropriate goals.

facilities.name: Max Fitness Chodov
facilities.description: The fitness center on the 2nd floor above the car center near Decathlon and MOL offers a wide range of Precor weight machines, a fully equipped cardio zone, a shared Finnish sauna with a relaxation zone, which is free of charge as part of a fitness visit, and a solarium. Free parking for 3 hours.

facilities.name: Max Fitness Letiště Ruzyně
facilities.description: A smaller but modern self-service branch located in the Airport Business Centre building right next to Prague Airport. Members can work out comfortably without a reception desk - entry is fully digital via the My Max Fitness mobile app or the My MultiSport app.

facilities.name: Max Fitness Praha Lužiny
facilities.description: The 1,400 m² fitness center on the 3rd floor of the Lužiny shopping center offers modern Precor equipment, a free Finnish sauna and an Ergoline solarium. The branch is easily accessible due to its proximity to the Lužiny metro station. Measurements on the InBody device allow you to track your progress and optimize your training plans.
